reason.observed_failure: Blob-filtered materialization invoked git diff --numstat once per recoverable pull request, causing lazy blob fetches and no bounded progress output.

protocol_change.description: Persist the already-declared, point-in-time opening-event additions, deletions, and changed_files fields. Extract exact path names from local Git trees with lazy fetching disabled. Use provider aggregates only when changed_files exactly equals the Git path manifest and the configured scope excludes no changed path.
protocol_change.unavailable_quantities: Per-file churn and change entropy remain unknown; they are never imputed from aggregate statistics.
protocol_change.abstention: Missing commits, incomplete opening statistics, path-count disagreement, excluded paths, mixed scope, and content-requiring packs retain the existing safe fallback or abstain. No later pull-request head may replace the opening SHA.

outcome_blinding: The added fields were named as the vocabulary design source in the original preregistration and are observed at PR opening. No feature-label association, learned rule, baseline result, or holdout metric was inspected before this amendment.
